name: Rhapsody's Tale
summary: After Rhapsody Shindigger gets his Kalimdor Kocktail, he tells of the flight with Brohann Caskbelly. He gives you an Atal'ai Tablet Fragment to take to Brohann in Stormwind.

sections.title: A Fragment for Brohann
sections.body: Rhapsody Shindigger tells you what happened after the kocktail. Before the flight, he drank a whole keg of stout while Brohann followed him through the sky. Rhapsody kept a troll souvenir, an Atal'ai Tablet Fragment. Now he asks you to take it to Brohann Caskbelly in Stormwind.

sections.title: Where the Flight Ended
sections.body: Rhapsody saw no temple from the air. A little too tipsy, he fell from his mount and plunged into the water. The current pulled him down among creepy trolls, and he swam out fast with a souvenir. Brohann's temple lies below the water.

faq.q: Who receives the Atal'ai Tablet Fragment?
aliases: who do i give the fragment to
faq.answer: Take the Atal'ai Tablet Fragment to Brohann Caskbelly in Stormwind.

faq.q: What does Rhapsody remember of the flight with Brohann?
faq.answer: Before the flight, Rhapsody drank a whole keg of stout, then flew through the sky with Brohann following behind.
Rhapsody's Kalimdor Kocktail came first. He would not tell the tale until the drink was made.
